name: @red-cup-engineering/earning-loop-worker-service
description: Earning loops with no house machine in the loop: a dependency-free Cloudflare Worker cron that receives and corroborates an x402 seller's settlements against two public Base providers, keeps every listed offer buyable, proposes self-adjusting price directives from what buyers revealed, writes a weekly earnings scorecard, and drives an on-chain engine's scan hook. Parameterized by an Operations record.

scripts.check: node --check worker/earning-loops.mjs && node --check scripts/deploy.mjs && node --check scripts/apply-price-directives.mjs
